en: Matthew 28

p.src: 1  Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

ja: けごろ、マグダラのマリアともう
en: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
u.src: 1  Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

p.src: 2  Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

en: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
u.src: 2  Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

p.src: 3  His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

ja: その姿は稲妻のようで、衣は雪のように白かった。
zh: 他的相貌如同閃電，衣服潔白如雪。
en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
u.src: 3  His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

p.src: 4  For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

en: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
u.src: 4  For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

p.src: 5  The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

していることは分かっている。
en: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
u.src: 5  The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

p.src: 6  He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

ja: イエスはここにはおられない。
われたとおり、よみがえられたからである。
en: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
u.src: 6  He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

p.src: 7  Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

en: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
u.src: 7  Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

p.src: 8  They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

en: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
u.src: 8  They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

p.src: 9  As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

ja: 弟子たちに知らせに行く途中、
en: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
u.src: 9  As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

p.src: 10  Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

くよう伝えなさい。そこで
en: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
u.src: 10  Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

ja: 28:10 ここで「兄弟」と訳された言葉は、「兄弟姉妹」または「きょうだい」と訳すこともできる。
en: 28:10 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 11  Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

en: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
u.src: 11  Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

p.src: 12  When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

en: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

u.src: 13  saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

p.src: 14  If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

en: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

en: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

en: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

p.src: 18  Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

en: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
